nodes.title: SessionLease + fencing generation

nodes.title: Protocol-state persistence

nodes.title: ContextEpoch

nodes.title: Path-scoped lazy rules

nodes.title: EnvironmentSnapshot / Revision

nodes.title: Renderer→bridge→privileged host boundaries
